title: The Mirari Sword Wounds Jeska
summary: Under the Mirari's influence, Kamahl nearly kills Jeska, beginning a transformation he cannot reverse.
narrative: The Mirari amplified Kamahl's violent ambition as he attempted to assert leadership among the Pardic tribes.
When Jeska confronted him, he stabbed her with his Mirari sword. The wound resisted ordinary healing and eventually contributed to her transformation into Phage.
